generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The removal of the `output` field in `LookupJoin` (#PKRC4, #QEDKR, #1H2GK, #MSS2X, #8JGEF) and the corresponding updates in `Analyzer` (#GR3BZ) significantly reduce redundancy. By delegating output calculation to `Join.computeOutput`, the system ensures a single source of truth for join schemas.

In `Join.java` (#GMBH8), the filter predicates use `== false`:
```java
.filter(attr -> matchFieldNames.contains(attr.name()) == false)
```
While functionally correct, using the logical NOT operator (`!`) is more idiomatic in Java:
`.filter(attr -> !matchFieldNames.contains(attr.name()))`.
